oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an Oil Control System (OCS) that calculates engine oil and filter change intervals based on driving conditions. Light driving conditions (freeway, city flat/moderate hills, no towing, no extended idling) result in normal display timing. Extreme conditions (repeated short trips under 5 miles, short trips under 10 miles in below-freezing temps, hot weather stop-and-go traffic, extensive idling/low-speed driving, towing/camper/car-top carrier, frequent braking/mountainous driving, sustained high speed driving) result in early display timing. If the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change oil within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). If the OCS resets prematurely or becomes inoperative, change oil within 6 months or 3,750 miles (6,000 km) from last oil change. After oil change, reset the Oil Control System and oil and filter maintenance reminder.
severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
extraction_caveats: 1. The maintenance schedule page 549 states 'up to 120,000 miles (192,000 km)/96 months' and 'After 120,000 miles (192,000 km)/96 months, continue maintenance at the same mileage/time intervals.' However, the KR15DDT-specific schedule header on page 551 states 'After 90,000 miles (144,000 km)/144 months, continue maintenance at the same mileage/time interval.' These two statements appear contradictory; the KR15DDT-specific schedule pages provided extend through 90,000 miles/144 months. 2. Engine coolant replacement interval (105,000 miles/7 years) is stated in the coolant description text (page 505) but does not appear as an explicit line item in the maintenance schedule pages provided; it is captured based on the text statement. 3. CVT fluid capacity is not listed on the provided pages. 4. AWD coupling oil capacity is not listed in the provided pages. 5. Brake fluid specification is not listed in the provided pages. 6. The In-cabin microfilter appears at every 11,250-mile interval in the schedule (11,250 / 22,500 / 33,750 / 45,000 / 56,250 / 67,500 / 78,750 / 90,000). The Intelligent Key battery is inspected at 11,250 and replaced starting at 22,500, then every 11,250 miles thereafter. 7. Intercooler coolant is described as 'maintenance-free' (page 548); no scheduled replacement interval is given. 8. Engine valve clearance is listed as inspect 'only if valve noise increases' — no fixed interval; omitted from scheduled items. 9. Fuel filter is listed as 'periodic maintenance is not required (in-tank type filter)'; omitted. 10. Engine drive belts first appear at 30,000 miles, then every 7,500 miles thereafter through 90,000 miles. 11. Page 404 content (ProPILOT Assist steering) is not relevant to maintenance schedules and was removed from source_pages.
